# Pinned exactly: the Qt build determines the WebEngine resource files
# (v8_context_snapshot.bin, *.pak, icudtl.dat). Keep Qt stable and bump only
# intentionally; the external update helper can replace all files, so
# Qt-crossing updates are still safe. PySide6 wheels carry the Qt/WebEngine
# binaries themselves (Essentials = core Qt, Addons = QtWebEngine etc.).
# Bump all three together.
# NOTE: PySide6 (LGPL v3) replaced PyQt6 (GPL v3) so the closed-source binary
# distribution stays license-compliant. Do NOT reintroduce PyQt6.
